name: False Profits
overview: Scripture warns believers to be vigilant against false prophets who disguise themselves as harmless but are inwardly destructive, deceiving many with counterfeit signs and teachings. Jesus cautions that these deceivers may even attempt to mislead the elect through great wonders. The apostle Paul urges Christians to identify and avoid those who cause division by promoting doctrines contrary to the gospel they have received, and to beware of philosophies and empty deceit that draw away from Christ. Together, these passages emphasize the necessity of discernment rooted in sound doctrine to guard the church from spiritual deception.
